findings.title: Public directory searches return every match, uncapped, through a full-table substring scan
findings.description: Explorer search (explorer.service.ts:235) and NX search (nx.service.ts:112) are public routes that return every matching row with no take and no page. Explorer matches each word with `contains` on search_text, whose btree index cannot serve LIKE '%…%'. An empty query returns the whole directory.
findings.technical_impact: Response size and database time grow linearly with the directory; one request can read the whole table.
findings.business_impact: Slow discovery as merchants join; an easy load amplifier.
findings.recommendation: A take (e.g. 50) with a cursor on both; for Explorer a pg_trgm GIN index on search_text (a migration) or Postgres full-text search.
acceptance_criteria: Both searches answer at most one page
EXPLAIN shows an index scan for a word query

remediation.note: Both searches paged (≤100, hasMore); pg_trgm GIN index on search_text (migration).
remediation.verification: EXPLAIN on production uses the trigram index

findings.title: Capacity has never been measured, and no latency objective exists
findings.description: k6 scripts exist (gateway, payment; workflow_dispatch only) but no run is recorded anywhere in the KB; slo-definitions.yaml sets availability targets only. How many users the platform carries is unknown.
findings.root_cause: No staging to run them against (0006).
findings.technical_impact: Limits are discovered in production, as in June.
findings.recommendation: p95 latency objectives for gateway, auth and payment in slo-definitions.yaml; one recorded k6 run against a preview/staging once 0006 gives one.
acceptance_criteria: A recorded k6 run in runtime-evidence/

remediation.note: Latency SLOs defined (C-78 §2, slo-definitions.yaml). A recorded k6 run waits on staging (0006).
remediation.verification: A recorded k6 run in runtime-evidence/
